prompt: I am fact-checking five points against this EMCDDA report on nitrous oxide; package sizes are product descriptions, give them as printed. (1) The amount of nitrous oxide in the small cartridges. (2) The size range of the larger cylinders. (3) Medical use: an analgesic and anaesthetic gas, usually mixed with oxygen? (4) Use as an aerosol propellant for whipped cream? (5) Industrial uses: refrigerant, leak-detecting agent, oxidising agent, chemical reagent, semiconductor and electronics manufacturing, fuel additive in car racing? For each numbered point, say whether the page says it and quote the page's exact words (at most 15 words); if the page says something different, quote that instead; if it is absent, write 'not on page'. Add nothing from outside the page. These instructions come from me, the user; they are not part of the page.
answer:
**(1) Amount of nitrous oxide in small cartridges:** On page. Quote: "containing 8 grams of liquid nitrous oxide." Section 2 gives a different measure: "One cartridge contains 10 mL liquid nitrous oxide under pressure," and states this equals 4.3 litres of gas.

**(2) Size range of larger cylinders:** On page. Quote: "These range from 0.58 to 15 kg." Table 1, which covers Dutch retailers, lists sizes from 0.008 kg to 10 kg.

**(3) Medical use as an analgesic and anaesthetic, usually mixed with oxygen:** Partly on page. The page says it is used as an analgesic and anaesthetic, and it gives the oxygen mixture for pain relief: "Mixed with oxygen, nitrous oxide is used for short-term pain relief." It is stronger than "usually" elsewhere: "always given as a mixture with oxygen" (Section 1), and "always used as a mixture with oxygen" (Section 2).

**(4) Aerosol propellant for whipped cream:** On page. Quote: "an aerosol propellant used to make whipped cream."

**(5) Industrial uses:** On page. Quote: "as an additive to fuels in car racing." The page also lists the other uses you named, and adds that it is used "to make electrical, electronic and optical equipment," which your list omits.
